'''Rigby''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Imperial Guard]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3640 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Corellia|battle]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], Rigby led a unit in capturing the Daoba Hotel in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] and held dozens of civilians inside hostage for several days while they installed heavy artillery atop the building. However, his plan failed when he and his unit were killed by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and military effort and the hostages were freed.
